name: Die Rosenheim-Cops
description: A team of inspectors investigates murders in and around the small Upper Bavarian town of Rosenheim, and they still have plenty of time to see idyllic landscapes and luxurious pre-alpine villas and enjoy sumptuous Bavarian fare with beer.

videos.title: Der Jäger ist des Hasen Tod
Der Tod stand vor der Tür
Zu viel Geld, zu wenig Leben
Der Jäger ist des Jägers Tod
Bis dass der Tod sie scheidet
Mit Schwung in den Tod
videos.overview: A nude biker is found death.

videos.title: Wer zu viel weiß, ist früher tot
Wer zweimal stirbt, ist wirklich tot
Ein Teich, ein Frosch, ein Mord
Mord nach allen Regeln der Kunst
Ein Star, ein Bild, ein Mord
Vertrauen ist gut, Kontrolle ist besser
Der Letzte macht das Licht aus

Wenn der Tod beim Postmann klingelt
Ridden Out
videos.overview: Death at the Stud Farm: Georg Ritter, owner of the prestigious ‘Ritter’ riding facility, is found beaten to death. Inspectors Hofer and Bach take up the investigation.

videos.title: The dead man in the garden
Death in the fairy tale park
Two cases for Stadler
videos.overview: Detectives Stadler and Winter are called to Rosenheim city centre. Master baker Georg Schober lies dead in his bakery. They discover that he was having an affair with Isabell Weigel, the owner of the neighbouring shop.

videos.title: A real dream couple
videos.overview: Jan-Oliver Pöhlmann, author of celebrity biographies, is found by a married couple in the ice rink. Inspectors Winter and Aubinger find out more about his relationship with figure skater Diana Dressler.

videos.title: Death on the coach
videos.overview: ‘There was a dead body,’ and of all places, it was on the Rottaler coach that Miriam Stockl was planning to take to visit her friend in Paris. Detectives Hansen and Aubinger investigate.

videos.title: Thieves robbed
videos.overview: Eberl, chairman of the Amaringer Burschenverein, is shot dead while guarding the maypole that the Amaringer stole from the Burschenverein in Walpertskirchen. Police Director Achtziger and Chief Inspector Hansen investigate.

videos.title: A bankruptcy with profit
videos.overview: A fisherman discovers a body in the lake. Detectives Hansen and Stadler investigate. It turns out that the dead man is fisherman Boris Staufer.

videos.title: In the name of the family
videos.overview: Heidi Möhring is found beaten to death on her terrace after returning from Salzburg, where she had been on holiday with her friend Bärbel. Detectives Hansen and Stadler investigate.

videos.title: The dead man in the freezer
videos.overview: The owner of a well-known event agency, Günther Beck, is found dead in the company's freezer. Detectives Stadler and Hansen investigate.

videos.title: Deadly vertigo
videos.overview: Nutritionist Lina Gebauer is found stabbed to death in the doctor's office where she worked. Detectives Stadler and Winter take up the investigation.

videos.title: Green is death
videos.overview: Gardener Johannes Herbig was killed with a hoe at the Benkelmann nursery. Detectives Winter and Stadler investigate Herbig's work environment.

videos.title: Murderous will
videos.overview: Ferdi Niedermayer, a carver of Perchten masks, is murdered in his workshop. Detectives Stadler and Winter initially suspect his half-brother Jakob Niedermayer.

videos.title: An artistic sensation
videos.overview: Restorer Peter Schönherr is found murdered in the pool of Dr Glaser's villa. Detectives Winter and Stadler are faced with a mystery.

videos.title: Teatime for a murderer
videos.overview: Zita Waldner, owner of the Hotel Sonnenblick, invites Marie and Achtziger to tea in her hotel's tea room. The occasion is Mrs Waldner's 75th birthday.

videos.title: Beauty with obstacles
videos.overview: Cosmetic surgeon Dr Kossin is found stabbed to death in his practice. Inspectors Stadler and Hansen quickly identify the first suspects: his wife Isabella stands to inherit a fortune. She would therefore have a motive for getting the celebrity doctor out of the way.

videos.title: A hairy case
videos.overview: Robert Döbl was stabbed to death. His boss found the employee dead in his workshop in the morning. Inspectors Hansen and Stadler investigate. Zirngibl himself is among the suspects, as Robert had stolen 5,000 euros from him.

videos.title: Three's a crowd
videos.overview: Building contractor and bon vivant Heiko Berg was drowned in his pool. Detectives Stadler and Hansen quickly manage to identify the first suspects. Initially, Veronika Berg, the victim's wife, comes under the investigators' scrutiny.

videos.title: Only the forest was a witness
videos.overview: Miriam Stockl wanted to take part in a forest bathing course led by Niklas Färber. But Färber does not show up for the course. He was beaten to death in the forest. Detectives Stadler and Hansen investigate. Judith Färber comes under suspicion.

videos.title: The party is over
videos.overview: Event manager Jan König was beaten to death on the premises of a company that rents out storage rooms. Jan König had moved luxury goods from his apartment to one of these storage rooms for safekeeping. He had embezzled profits from his agency.

videos.title: His biggest deal
videos.overview: Heir investigator Leonhard was murdered. Detectives Hansen and Kaya discover that his death must be connected to his last case. It involved a certain Wilfried, who left behind a multi-million-dollar inheritance.

videos.title: The emperor's last hour
videos.overview: When pathologist Sandra Mai takes her watch to be repaired, she finds the shop owner Nikolaus Kaiser murdered. The Rosenheim CID team immediately begins its investigation.

videos.title: Murder from the air
videos.overview: Building contractor Bernd Dreiberg lies dead at the foot of a slope, his wrecked e-bike beside him. At first glance, it looks like a tragic accident.

videos.title: Three Graces and a Death
videos.overview: The beauty contest ‘The Golden Orchid’ is celebrating its 40th anniversary. But before it can take place, the main sponsor, Ludwig Kärger, is found dead in the posh hotel ‘Kaiserhof’.

videos.title: A man for life
videos.overview: Dr. Sibylle Teufel lies dead in her dental practice, killed with a larger-than-life molar model. Detectives Hansen and Kaya quickly identify the first suspects.

videos.title: Engaged or dead
videos.overview: When tax officer Cony Sommerer is found beaten to death, detectives Stadler and Winter take up the investigation. At first, Cony's partner comes under suspicion, but gradually more and more suspects emerge.

videos.title: One way to death
videos.overview: One of the three managing directors of a timber wholesaler, Hannes Mayerthaler, has been stabbed to death. He allegedly wanted to sell the company to investor Josef Dreisacker. Detectives Stadler and Winter quickly identify the first suspects.

videos.title: Everyone wants Mai
videos.overview: Chemist Claudia Steinheim is found dead in the laboratory of her institute for food technology. Detectives Stadler and Winter take up the investigation.

videos.title: A very special recording
videos.overview: The well-known former pianist and harpsichord lover Rüdiger Wickert is found beaten to death in his refuge, a forest hut. Stadler and Winter have an initial suspicion.

videos.title: The old barge
videos.overview: Moritz Köbl has been shot dead. He was the owner and captain of the new excursion boat ‘Seeperle’, which was to be christened the next day. Detectives Stadler and Winter investigate.

videos.title: A flawless murder
videos.overview: Personal trainer Julian Safranski is found dead. Someone has mixed poison into his fitness drink. But who could have had a reason to murder him? Inspectors Winter and Stadler investigate.

videos.title: Celebrate when you can
videos.overview: Quarterback Thomas Brandlmaier lies dead in the equipment room of the Rosenheim Strikers. Detectives Anton Stadler and Sven Hansen take up the investigation.

videos.title: More appearance than reality
videos.overview: Stefan Schätzel, owner of an organic inn, was pushed from the balcony. Detectives Hansen and Stadler initially suspect his wife Luise. The victim had recently been having an affair with Franziska Hirsch.

videos.title: The kidnapped bride
videos.overview: During the evening wedding reception, Sabine Lechner is murdered after being kidnapped. Detectives Hansen and Stadler immediately begin their investigation. The first suspects, such as the newlywed husband, are quickly found.

videos.title: Everything comes to an end
videos.overview: Shortly before the opening match of the Mangfall Open, coach Brigitta Roth is found dead. Her rival Sarah Schneider quickly comes under the scrutiny of detectives Hansen and Stadler, as Roth had poached a talented young player from her.

videos.title: Who would expect murder?
videos.overview: The young mathematician Arne Hellmann is found dead in the Rosenschlössl, where he lives as part of his studies. Initial investigations lead detectives Stadler and Hansen to suspect that Hellmann was an impostor.

videos.title: The unfinished
videos.overview: Heinrich Gschwendtner, nude painter and lecturer, was killed with his painting stool while practising his profession. Hansen and Stadler have a new case. Initial investigations lead to Gschwendtner's model Corinna Hüfner and her fiancé Timo Ritter.

videos.title: Star Wars
videos.overview: Georg Vorreiter is found beaten to death on the lawn of his farm. As Inspector Hansen is going on holiday, Inspector Stadler investigates for the first time with his new colleague Birte Andresen from Hamburg.

videos.title: Rosenheim from above
videos.overview: Marie Hofer finds drone pilot Moritz Schwinghammer murdered on the Heuberg. He was supposed to produce the city's new image film, ‘Rosenheim from above’.

videos.title: The kidnapped bull
videos.overview: Successful cattle breeder Anna Wenzl is found beaten to death in the stable of her valuable breeding bull Herrmann. Detectives Stadler and Andresen take up the investigation. The investigative duo quickly find their first suspects.

videos.title: A surprising reunion
videos.overview: Bertram Neustädt is found stabbed to death on an alpaca farm leased to the Nerlingers. Could they have witnessed the crime? As detectives Stadler and Andresen discover, Neustädt had been living there temporarily.

videos.title: Saving money has its price
videos.overview: Farmer Alois Kandler is found dead in his barn, killed by a hay crane. Inspectors Stadler and Andresen begin their investigation. At the time of the crime, it appears that only his daughter Vroni was with him on the farm.

videos.title: Stadler home alone
videos.overview: Journalist Jochen Hanke is found dead in his living room by his wife Cornelia. Detectives Stadler and Andresen immediately begin their investigation.

videos.title: The death of the rich man
videos.overview: Large-scale farmer Christoph Meindl from nearby Meinersbach is found dead on the railway tracks, stabbed to death. Initially, Monika Schlosser, the landlady of the village inn, is suspected. She had a secret relationship with the large-scale farmer.

videos.title: The water of happiness
videos.overview: Nature ranger Bartholomäus Kolb is found in the Klimmbach stream. He did not drown, but was murdered. Initially, a trail leads to his wife Marion. But soon, Stadler and Andresen focus their attention on other suspects.

videos.title: Wedding in Rosenheim
videos.overview: Chimney sweep Peter Pracht has been murdered. His boss Quirin Lachner is a suspect. Detectives Stadler and Andresen discover that he and the victim had committed burglaries together.

videos.title: On the horse
videos.overview: Successful and internationally renowned master saddler Andreas Pause is found beaten to death in his workshop. Detectives Hansen and Kaya take up the investigation. The first suspects are not long in coming.

videos.title: Robber Frantz returns
videos.overview: Author Johannes Weyrich is found murdered in his villa by his housekeeper Anna Linzer. Detectives Hansen and Kaya take up the investigation. The first suspects quickly come into the investigators' focus.

videos.title: The new girl and the ex
A case of tall tales
videos.overview: Roland Heise, the well-known ‘dumpling king of Rosenheim,’ was found beaten to death in his office in the morning. There is no trace of the murder weapon. Meanwhile, Jo promises dishes made with fish he caught himself on his evening menu at ‘Times Square.’

videos.title: Order is half the battle
videos.overview: Successful sound therapist Angela Rasch is found dead in her living room. At first glance, it looks like a robbery-murder, but detectives Stadler and Andresen have their doubts.

videos.title: The unknown relative
videos.overview: Guest Fineas Kamal is poisoned at Gerlinde Meyr's guesthouse. A few days earlier, he had arrived in Rosenheim and claimed to be the Egyptian nephew of the guesthouse owner.

videos.title: For the love of nature
videos.overview: A bank advisor is found beaten to death on the jetty in the morning. Inspector Andresen, who wanted to go sailing on her day off, discovers him. She quickly realises that a rich widow and her nephew are suspects.

videos.title: A very crooked deal
videos.overview: A perfumer is found beaten to death in his fragrance laboratory in the morning. The detectives quickly determine that shortly before his death, his wife learned about his speculative investments in cryptocurrencies and his mistress.

videos.title: A false scent
videos.overview: Perfumer Paul Lahr is found beaten to death in his fragrance laboratory in the morning. He was planning to sell his company soon. Who would benefit from his death?

videos.title: Blown away
videos.overview: Lukas Kreuzer is found lifeless in the Rosenheim city tower in the morning. As a ‘tower watchman,’ he blew the traditional signal every hour in the evening from the Rosenheim city tower with a trumpet.

videos.title: Every fall a hit
videos.overview: Max Ehrmann, a participant in a summer biathlon team training camp, is found dead on the training track in the morning by police officers Mohr and Moosacher.

videos.title: No dead priest
videos.overview: A priest is found murdered on the banks of the Mangfall. In reality, however, it is Johannes Felbinger, who was dressed as a priest for Gisela Bindrum's motto festival.

videos.title: The perfect man
videos.overview: In the morning, Baumgartl, a legal assistant at the Hanewinkel notary's office, is found beaten to death. Does the murder have anything to do with a recently notarised real estate transaction?

videos.title: Nobility obliges
videos.overview: Gardener Max Treidl finds Viktor von Tauffenstein, a descendant of an old noble family, murdered in the family crypt of ‘the von Tauffensteins’.

videos.title: There was no body
videos.overview: Inspector Stadler investigates an agitated call from pension owner Senta Hofmeister, who claims that her neighbour Alois Lanzinger has murdered his wife.

videos.title: Now they're in a fine mess
videos.overview: The owner of a mattress shop is found stabbed to death on the terrace of his house by his neighbour. The detectives learn from her that he often argued with his ex-wife because he was increasingly neglecting the house and garden

videos.title: A lesson for Stadler
videos.overview: Bavarian pop star Schorsch Schöpfer is found dead in his hotel room in the morning by his agent Ilyas Kaptan. Detectives Stadler and Beck take up the investigation.

videos.title: The beauty of Rosenheim
videos.overview: Ms Stockl learns that rose grower Neubauer has been stabbed to death in his greenhouse. Detectives Stadler and Beck take up the investigation.

videos.title: Murder among tenants
videos.overview: Manfred Laxmaier is found dead in the stairwell of his apartment building. Detectives Sven Hansen and Kilian Kaya take up the investigation. Laxmaier's three tenants are suspected of the crime.

videos.title: An expensive evening
videos.overview: Well-known stock market guru Kassian Dobler is found dead in his hotel room in the morning. It quickly becomes clear that he was poisoned. Inspectors Hansen and Kaya investigate.

videos.title: The last headline
videos.overview: Karl-Heinz Becker, editor-in-chief of the tabloid ‘Rosenheim aktuell’, is found dead in the editorial office. Inspectors Kaya and Hansen quickly identify suspects.

videos.title: The broker from the lake
videos.overview: Markus Krone, who runs a brokerage firm with his wife Bettina, is found beaten to death in the garden of a lakeside property. And it is Inspector Hansen, of all people, who finds the body.

videos.title: A Night in the Forest
videos.overview: Theodor Grundler, founder of an automotive supplier, is found dead in his tent during a management retreat in the forest. Detectives Stadler and Beck investigate. The purpose of the event was not only to strengthen the management team, but also to announce Grundler's successor, as he wanted to retire.

videos.title: A brilliant idea
videos.overview: Johannes Steinbacher, former owner of the Steinbacher carpentry shop, is found dead next to the tavern in the morning, killed with a beer mug. Inspectors Stadler and Beck investigate. The night before, he had celebrated his retirement with his entire staff at the tavern.

videos.title: Oh, how beautiful is California
videos.overview: Melanie Scherenberg is found shot dead in the Goossens auction house, where she worked as an art expert. At first, everything looks like a burglary. However, detectives Anton Stadler and Sandra Hecht quickly become convinced that it is a murder.

videos.title: The key to the solution
videos.overview: In the village of Untergriebensbach near Rosenheim, kiosk owner Traudl Brenner is murdered. Detectives Anton Stadler and Sandra Hecht take up the investigation.

videos.title: Anniversary in Rosenheim
videos.overview: Elections for the office of president are coming up at the exclusive Hoheneck riding club. Then Hannes Kolbe, the club's farrier, is found beaten to death.

videos.title: Murder also makes manure
videos.overview: Farmer Alfred Kühbandner was fatally struck by an arrow, apparently from a distance injection blowpipe. Remnants of his will are found in the manure heap.

videos.title: Stockl's Suspicion
videos.overview: Company boss Ferdinand Lob is found lifeless in his villa. At first, everything points to a natural cause of death.

videos.title: The Choir Shadow
videos.overview: Jonas Nölle is beaten to death in his apartment on the evening of his engagement party. Inspectors Anton Stadler and Sandra Hecht immediately begin their investigation.

videos.title: Stadler's Barn Festival
videos.overview: Matthias Fink lies next to a stolen luxury car: previously convicted of robbing a diamond dealer, he has now been run over. Detectives Hansen and Kaya investigate.

videos.title: The Man Must Go
videos.overview: Herbert Poltschuster, who successfully breeds dwarf rabbits in his spare time, is found dead in his garden – beaten to death with the winner's trophy for a rabbit.

videos.title: Quite presumptuous
videos.overview: Erich Schaller is found beaten to death in his distillery. He had invented a rose gin that turned out to be a sales hit. Detectives Hansen and Kaya investigate.

videos.title: A smart house
videos.overview: Successful photographer Dieter Ludewig lies beaten to death in the photo studio of his smart house. Detectives Hansen and Kaya quickly identify suspects.

videos.title: A huge problem
videos.overview: The murder of the supposed businessman ‘Wolfram Bertele’ in the spa gardens of Bad Aibling presents detectives Sven Hansen and Kilian Kaya with a mystery.

videos.title: Cut out
videos.overview: Bertram Hintereder, a celebrity hairdresser from Rosenheim, is found stabbed to death in his salon. Detectives Hansen and Kaya take up the investigation.

videos.title: Wiebke's mountaineer
videos.overview: A woman is found stabbed to death on the banks of the Inn. The evening before, Inspector Hansen had invited her on a sailing trip that morning.

videos.title: Mirror, mirror
videos.overview: Franz Poschel, Karl Schretzmayer's opponent in the mayoral election in Ganting, is found shot dead. Detectives Hansen and Kaya investigate.

videos.title: The Double Knot
videos.overview: Dr. Silke Brohm was murdered at a cardiology conference in the conference hotel. Detectives Hansen and Kaya quickly manage to identify the first suspects.

videos.title: First Stolen, Then Robbed
videos.overview: Lorenz Schmalzgruber, owner of Landmaschinen Schmalzgruber GmbH, is found dead in his exhibition hall. Inspectors Stadler and Schubert take up the investigation.

videos.title: The stain must go
videos.overview: Prosecutor Zacharias Zaumseil is found shot dead in his office. Inspectors Stadler and Schubert immediately take up the investigation.

videos.title: No rose without thorns
videos.overview: The famous garden architect Alfred Spitzlberger is found stabbed to death in his home. Detectives Stadler and Schubert quickly identify the first suspects.

videos.title: An unexpected visit
videos.overview: Plastic surgeon Johann Maßenstein had been missing for six weeks when his body was found hidden in a forest. Detectives Stadler and Beck take on the case. Forensic pathologist Dr Elena Dimos determines that the man died only a few days earlier, but the cause of death remains a mystery. The detectives begin a complicated investigation into the man's family and business environment.

videos.title: A brilliant business
videos.overview: Rainer Fuchs, owner of the pet funeral home ‘Ruhe sanft’ (Rest in Peace), is found dead in his office by his wife Eva. A new case for detectives Anton Stadler and Julia Beck. It turns out that someone had put poison in the tea that Fuchs brewed every evening at 8 p.m. sharp.

videos.title: Mrs Meyr goes online
videos.overview: Gerhard Nebeling is found beaten to death in the co-working space from which the digital nomad had most recently operated his internet sales platform. Detectives Stadler and Beck investigate. The first suspects are the landlords of Nebeling's temporary workplace: Boris Lengauer accused his wife Katrin of having an affair with Nebeling.

videos.title: A job for Wiebke
videos.overview: An impoverished noblewoman is found beaten to death in a retirement home. The caretaker, who did not want her to report him for growing cannabis, comes under suspicion. Another noblewoman who profited from the cannabis cultivation also comes under suspicion.

videos.title: Nice acquaintances
videos.overview: After an award ceremony for Mr Achtziger, Jo finds catering employee Isabell Wanninger dead. Inspectors Hansen and Kaya take up the investigation.

videos.title: An unbelievable affair
videos.overview: Jasper Berg, co-founder of a software company, is found murdered in his holiday home. Detectives Hansen and Kaya immediately begin their investigation.

videos.title: A highly intelligent society
videos.overview: Kurt Fehrenbacher, honorary professor and chairman of an association for highly intelligent people, died after smoking a poisoned cigar. The detectives investigate.

videos.title: Hansen's new brother
videos.overview: Roman Wallner is killed on a remote road between the Bad Aibling districts of Mainz and Bilch. Detectives Hansen and Kaya begin their investigation.

videos.title: If it doesn't fit, make it fit.
